complexity.notes: No hashing is used (membership test is on a 3-element list), so the O(n) bound holds in the worst case. Correct but slightly clunky: a dict mapping closers to openers would avoid the repetitive elif chain; also note each elif pops exactly once, so there is no double-pop bug, but the style invites one.
complexity.summary: Classic stack-based validation: push opening brackets, and on each closing bracket check that the popped top matches the corresponding opening type; the string is valid iff the stack is empty at the end.
